purpose: Machine-readable record of the commercial values captured from official Amazon search-result pages on 2026-11-13. Namespaced under c4e71983 because main's data/products.json schema is owned by session 7f84fea4 and its FLG-004 marks price, rating and review counts as unverified. This file is offered as evidence for that flag, not as a replacement for the canonical product rows.
method: Values were read from Amazon search-result pages. The capture timestamp for each product is the Unix epoch value of the 'qid' parameter Amazon returned with the page, decoded to UTC. Amazon rounds rating counts on search pages (for example '4.8K'), so rating_count_display is exact-as-shown and rating_count_exact is null.
compliance_warning: Program Policies, Participation Requirements section 2(b): a site may only show prices and availability if (a) Amazon serves the link in which they are displayed, or (b) the data was obtained via Creators API or PA API. These values were captured by hand. They are research evidence and must not be rendered on a monetised page until they come from one of those two routes. Logged as c4e71983-FLG-01.
